note: IA-1, owner xxxxxxxx-13 (2026-10-26, "Off + common words"): settings.pm reads idle_handoff_turn false, no, none, disabled or 0 (a JSON false too) as off and true, yes, 1 or on (a JSON true too) as auto, trimmed and case-folded; any other value reads as off ($IDLE_INVALID, one value with config.ts IDLE_INVALID_READS_AS) with a note /status shows. Before this ruling every unknown value read as auto. A value that is blank once trimmed (spaces, a tab) is unset, the default auto with no note, as config.ts unset() reads it (review r2: /status said off while the hooks ran auto). IDLE-COMPACT-SPEC §6.2: the idle_handoff_turn steps run with automatic compaction off in the user settings file (autoCompactEnabled false), where the line is the turn's alone; idle_compact (a new key) reads the same words the same way (config.ts idleCompact), with idleCompaction false: auto says the plugin compacts, off keeps the turn's text with (idle_compact: off), any other value is off with its note. Its default is auto; it has no legacy on note.
